purpose: Full-model CPU TGS mechanism diagnosis only; no production adoption or T3/T4.
intervention: Only tested-side two tilt joints friction + tested click qf; after loader, before first settle. Fresh scene per case. No other setter, no qf refresh per step.

H1.hypothesis: New effort friction removes near-lock induced by fictitious click preload under the original full-model TGS conditions.
H1.support: For each side/direction both effort_7p4 and zero_7p4 load peak >=1deg; legacy_7p4 <1deg in matching case supports replacement-restores-motion interpretation.
H1.scope: Motion is not cone/return or false-click acceptance; keep original cone scoring separately.

H2.hypothesis: Observe full-mechanism behavior at 0/2/7.4N preload; springs/closed loop can affect total angle.
H2.interpretation: No full-angle <5% friction claim. Observe q/qvel, angle, raw click travel/fraction, public signal and return; no new numerical pass threshold.

unchanged: dt/gravity/force/point/timing/drives/mass/inertia/collision/cone/iterations/sleep follow reused production cone executor; force and scoring are not reimplemented.

cpu_scene_adapter.reason: Existing create_scene(render=False) calls sapien.Scene(), whose default systems include RenderSystem in this wheel.
cpu_scene_adapter.implementation: Only experiment-local executor create_scene factory override: sapien.Scene([sapien.physx.PhysxCpuSystem()]); inherited scene config and original dt retained. No rendering/GPU, no public helper edits.

stop_policy: Critical gate stops batch; noncritical diagnostic failures do not stop 30 cases. No parameter tuning. Execution-bug repair budget 3.

repair_log.error: Missing XBOX_GAMEPAD_PHYSICS_RESOURCES environment variable required by reused executor
repair_log.fix: Forward validated --resources to process-local environment before loading

trace_join: state_trace.jsonl covers all 750 steps including settle; original cone trace.jsonl covers load/release 500 steps with actual force_world_n and point_world_m. Join cone step i with state step i+250 (zero based). Settle has no probe force.
